_schema._comment: roster.json — who the learners are and which badge program they are on. Written ONLY by case-track (add/retire a learner, award a badge). Never written by case-publish. A badge award is a human act recorded here after case-track reports the learner is eligible; case-track never awards one itself.

programs._comment: Badge structure per studio. cases_required = badges * cases_per_badge.

fields.badges: integer. Number of case-study badges in the program.
fields.cases_per_badge: integer. Completed cases needed to earn one badge.
fields.cases_required: integer. badges * cases_per_badge. The whole-program requirement.

learner_fields.id: string, slug. Stable primary key, referenced by submissions.json assignments[].learner_id, submissions[].learner_id and discussions[].learner_id.
learner_fields.program: enum: MS-Adventure | Launchpad. Selects the badge structure from programs{}.
learner_fields.cohort: string or null. Free-text group label used for bulk assignment, e.g. '2026-fall-adventure'.
learner_fields.status: enum: active | paused | alumni. Only 'active' learners appear in the exception queue.
learner_fields.started_on: ISO date. When the learner entered the program.
learner_fields.badges_earned: array of objects {badge_index (1-based int), awarded_on (ISO date), awarded_by (string), cases (array of case ids that satisfied it)}. Append-only. A badge is never auto-awarded by a skill.
learner_fields.drive_folder_id: string or null. The Google Drive folder id for this learner's submission intake (Roadmap C3, see skills/case-track/SKILL.md 'Drive intake'). null until case-track locates or creates 'Math Builder / Submissions / <display_name>/' and records the id here, same pattern as cases_index.json paths.drive_url.
learner_fields.drive_folder_url: string or null. Human-clickable link to the same folder, set alongside drive_folder_id.
learner_fields.notes: free text, facilitator-visible. Accommodations, context, sensitivity flags.

invariants: A case id appears in at most one badges_earned[].cases across a learner's record — a case counts once.
Records with _example: true are seed data for rendering only. Delete them before real use; case-track excludes them from every count unless run with include_examples.
drive_folder_id/drive_folder_url are set together or not at all — never one without the other.
